column1: # The resources.db patches the test server offers, at $SKHID_TEST_PATCHES_URL (never the live one).
# The server data is built of exactly these (release/build-server-db) and the
# server's /patches offers exactly these; a file on the patches server that is
# not here is offered to no one. release/upload-patch adds a row when it
# publishes a patch: commit it with the release's record. A row's patch is
# never changed (a published patch is never replaced: a fix is the next
# revision); one removed stops offering it, safe only while no player owns
# its items. The urls are the patch's addresses, one space apart, tried by
# the players' updater in this order: the patches server's first, then
# mirrors (8 at most), each checked by the release's preflight. More at
# once, without a release: release/add-mirror (srp's mirrors.tsv). The
# original game's archive is in release/game.tsv.
# One patch a line, in revision order, tabs between:
